value.rationale: The number of observable mathematical peaks in summed two-temperature emission is a motivated inverse-modelling question; the sharp critical hot/cool contrast (~2.15664) lies inside the temperature contrast range 2–4 of archived debris-disk studies. The theorem gives a complete necessary-and-sufficient all-strength phase diagram, identifies a quartically flat organizing cusp, and computes the 3/2 opening coefficient. These are structural and nontrivial consequences of different emissivity powers, not single-component peak exercises.
